name: Emerald Bay
source:
Emerald Bay is a visual novel taking place in the coastal city of it's namesake. You, the human main character, is a refugee from a faraway land and is now finding yourself in a country where your species is no longer the majority. 

[From [url=https://paxterra.itch.io/emerald-bay-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《翡翠湾》是一部发生在同名沿海城市的视觉小说。你，人类主角，是来自遥远土地的难民，现在发现自己身处一个你的物种不再占多数的国家。

[来自[url=https://paxterra.itch.io/emerald-bay-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
